Hi Lena —

Following up from our demo: attached is a concise scorecard and a mutual action playset that maps acceptance tests to owners and timelines. High level asks: can you confirm who on your side will own data provisioning and who will be the sign-off authority for go/no-go?

Summary (proposal):
- Success scorecard (primary KPIs):
  - Latency: p95 generation < 300ms on representative QPS
  - Accuracy: 95% pass on benchmark prompts (see sheet)
  - Cost: token cost under agreed threshold for 10k monthly queries
- Exit gates (must pass all):
  1) Baseline performance run with production-ish data (owner: CurePath Eng)
  2) Security checklist & SOC2 evidence validated (owner: CurePath Sec)
  3) Smoke test pass (automated runbook attached)
- Acceptance tests (examples):
  - End-to-end sample flow (10k tokens) with latency & error-tracking
  - Edge-case prompt list concordance > 90%

Attachments: [Attachment: Eval_Scorecard_v0.1.xlsx (xlsx)], [Attachment: MAP_Playset_Template.xlsx (xlsx)]

Proposed timeline:
- Week 1: data handoff and account setup (target: May 18)
- Week 2: smoke runs and initial QA (target: May 25)
- Week 3: joint review & final signoff (target: Jun 1)

Next steps: please review the scorecard, suggest edits inline on the MAP_Playset_Template, and confirm owners for the three exit gates above. If helpful I can create a HubSpot task list for each owner.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
